newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil active for second day.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil active for second day.

text.p: European low sulphur straight-run fuel oil had a second active day this week, with a cargo sold at a floating price due to the seller's perception of a worsening crack against crude.
An Irish refiner sold a 30,000-tonne cargo loading July 15-20 to a French refiner at mean fob July quote plus a premium of about $1.75.
The seller said it had received a bid at $104 fob, more than $3 to $4 over two deals on Monday, but it rejected it, saying the crack was bad.
